strings.scene.shang.tangdao.title: 网开三面
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.subtitle: 汤祷桑林
strings.vo.01: 汤还没有伐夏的时候，有一次出行，看见野外的人张网四面，祝祷说：天下四方的鸟都进我的网。
strings.vo.02: 汤说：这样就把它们捉尽了。他让人去掉三面，只留一面，祝道：想往左的往左，想往右的往右，不听命的，再进我的网。
strings.vo.03: 诸侯听说了，说汤的德行连禽兽都顾到了。后来汤灭了夏，回到亳都，作《汤诰》告诫诸侯。
strings.vo.04: 《吕氏春秋》又说，汤得天下之后，天大旱，五年没有收成。
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.quote: 欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.fork.prompt: 网开三面——依《史记》直书，还是听野史「以身祷于桑林」？
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·殷本纪》所载
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.canon.intro: 汤得了天下，第一件事是告诉诸侯：从今往后，有功于民的才能立国。他把这番话写成了《汤诰》。
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.end.canon: 汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.pick.legend: 野史 · 以身祷于桑林
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《吕氏春秋·季秋纪·顺民》与《墨子·兼爱下》：汤克夏后天大旱，汤以身为牺牲祷于桑林，剪发磨手，雨乃大至。这是战国诸子书中的传说。
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.legend.intro: 五年不雨。巫者说要用人来祭天。汤说：我来。
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.end.legend: 雨下来了。正史里的汤以网开三面示德，传说里的汤以身代民受罪。两者都在说同一种德行。
strings.scene.shang.tangdao.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若汤不去网（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 商 · （约前 1600 年）。夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。
setting.en: Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE), c. 1599 BCE — rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots.

characters.name: 汤
characters.zh: 汤（商·商王，名履）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；灭夏后还亳，作《汤诰》，改正朔
characters.en: Tang (汤) — ruler, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 张网者
characters.zh: 张网者（商·野外猎人）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；张网四面而祝
characters.en: Zhang Wangzhe (张网者) — commoner, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 伊尹
characters.zh: 伊尹（商·阿衡）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；辅汤定天下
characters.en: Yi Yin (伊尹) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 仲虺
characters.zh: 仲虺（商·左相）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；作诰以释汤之惭德
characters.en: Zhong Hui (仲虺) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 汤还没有伐夏的时候，有一次出行，看见野外的人张网四面，祝祷说：天下四方的鸟都进我的网。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–11 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：草、树、树冠｜动作：野外，四面张开的大网｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：鸟鸣｜后期叠加文字：片名「网开三面」竖排书法与朱印「汤诰」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汤还没有伐夏的时候，有一次出行，看见野外的人张网四面，祝祷说：天下四方的鸟都进我的网。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, trees, tree canopy | Action: In the wild a net is spread on all four sides | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: birdsong | Text added in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「网开三面」 with vermilion seal 「汤诰」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汤还没有伐夏的时候，有一次出行，看见野外的人张网四面，祝祷说：天下四方的鸟都进我的网。」

shots.vo: 汤说：这样就把它们捉尽了。他让人去掉三面，只留一面，祝道：想往左的往左，想往右的往右，不听命的，再进我的网。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（11–23 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：草；主体：汤、张网者｜动作：汤命人解去三面，只留一面｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：鸟鸣；音效：绳索｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汤说：这样就把它们捉尽了。他让人去掉三面，只留一面，祝道：想往左的往左，想往右的往右，不听命的，再进我的网。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (11–23 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Tang, Zhang Wangzhe | Action: Tang orders three sides removed, leaving only one | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: birdsong; SFX: rope | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汤说：这样就把它们捉尽了。他让人去掉三面，只留一面，祝道：想往左的往左，想往右的往右，不听命的，再进我的网。」

shots.vo: 诸侯听说了，说汤的德行连禽兽都顾到了。后来汤灭了夏，回到亳都，作《汤诰》告诫诸侯。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（23–33 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：众人、旌旗｜动作：亳都，诸侯列于阶下听诰｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜后期叠加文字：引文「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「诸侯听说了，说汤的德行连禽兽都顾到了。后来汤灭了夏，回到亳都，作《汤诰》告诫诸侯。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (23–33 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: crowd, banners | Action: At Bo the lords stand below the steps to hear his decree | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: vertical kaishu quotation 「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「诸侯听说了，说汤的德行连禽兽都顾到了。后来汤灭了夏，回到亳都，作《汤诰》告诫诸侯。」

shots.vo: 《吕氏春秋》又说，汤得天下之后，天大旱，五年没有收成。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（33–41 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山；中景：沙；主体：汤｜动作：大旱，田地龟裂，五年不收｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；干笔擦出沙地｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：干风｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「《吕氏春秋》又说，汤得天下之后，天大旱，五年没有收成。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (33–41 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sand; subject: Tang | Action: Great drought; the fields crack and nothing grows for five years | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: dry wind | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《吕氏春秋》又说，汤得天下之后，天大旱，五年没有收成。」

shots.vo: 汤走进了桑林——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（41–47 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓推到近景后定格成关键帧静帧，冲击靠剪辑｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：汤；题字「祷」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势｜动作：桑林之中，他剪下自己的头发｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨缓缓铺开后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：雷声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汤走进了桑林——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (41–47 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push to a close shot that holds as a keyframe still; impact comes from the edit | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Tang; calligraphy 「祷」 added in post; the frame keeps only the dry-brush gesture | Action: In the mulberry grove he cuts off his own hair | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big ink wash spreads slowly, then holds as a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: thunder | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汤走进了桑林——」

shots.vo: 汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（47–55 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：汤｜动作：正史结局：汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (47–55 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Tang | Action: Canonical outcome: Tang reforms the calendar and colours of state; the institutions of Shang are founded. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。」

shots.vo: 欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（55–61 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸，左侧留出竖排引文的位置，右下角留出朱印的位置（文字与印章后期叠加）｜动作：纸面静止，只有淡墨水痕缓缓洇开；后期叠加引文逐字显现、朱印落下｜水墨效果：淡墨水痕洇开，纸纹若隐若现｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜后期叠加文字：引文「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」——《史记·殷本纪》，竖排楷书；朱印「汤诰」｜旁白：「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (55–61 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper with space on the left for a vertical quotation and at lower right for the seal (both added in post) | Action: the paper stays still with only a pale ink bleed spreading; in post the quotation appears character by character and the seal stamps last | Ink FX: pale ink bleed spreading, faint paper grain | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | Text added in post: quotation 「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」 — 《史记·殷本纪》, vertical kaishu; vermilion seal 「汤诰」 | VO (Mandarin): 「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：鸟鸣、宫殿回响、战后余风、寂静室内；音效：绳索、青铜钟声、干风、雷声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: birdsong, palace hall reverb, lingering wind after battle, quiet room tone; SFX: rope, bronze bell, dry wind, thunder; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「网开三面」、副题「汤祷桑林」、朱印「汤诰」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」——《史记·殷本纪》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「网开三面」, subtitle 「汤祷桑林」 and vermilion seal 「汤诰」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」 — 《史记·殷本纪》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 汤还没有伐夏的时候，有一次出行，看见野外的人张网四面，祝祷说：天下四方的鸟都进我的网。
汤说：这样就把它们捉尽了。他让人去掉三面，只留一面，祝道：想往左的往左，想往右的往右，不听命的，再进我的网。
诸侯听说了，说汤的德行连禽兽都顾到了。后来汤灭了夏，回到亳都，作《汤诰》告诫诸侯。
《吕氏春秋》又说，汤得天下之后，天大旱，五年没有收成。
汤走进了桑林——
汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。
欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】商 · 网开三面（汤祷桑林）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 61 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：商 · （约前 1600 年）。夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。

人物：
- 汤（商·商王，名履）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；灭夏后还亳，作《汤诰》，改正朔
- 张网者（商·野外猎人）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；张网四面而祝
- 伊尹（商·阿衡）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；辅汤定天下
- 仲虺（商·左相）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；作诰以释汤之惭德

分镜：
镜头 1（0–11 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：草、树、树冠｜动作：野外，四面张开的大网｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：鸟鸣｜后期叠加文字：片名「网开三面」竖排书法与朱印「汤诰」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汤还没有伐夏的时候，有一次出行，看见野外的人张网四面，祝祷说：天下四方的鸟都进我的网。」
镜头 2（11–23 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：草；主体：汤、张网者｜动作：汤命人解去三面，只留一面｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：鸟鸣；音效：绳索｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汤说：这样就把它们捉尽了。他让人去掉三面，只留一面，祝道：想往左的往左，想往右的往右，不听命的，再进我的网。」
镜头 3（23–33 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：众人、旌旗｜动作：亳都，诸侯列于阶下听诰｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜后期叠加文字：引文「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「诸侯听说了，说汤的德行连禽兽都顾到了。后来汤灭了夏，回到亳都，作《汤诰》告诫诸侯。」
镜头 4（33–41 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山；中景：沙；主体：汤｜动作：大旱，田地龟裂，五年不收｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；干笔擦出沙地｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：干风｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「《吕氏春秋》又说，汤得天下之后，天大旱，五年没有收成。」
镜头 5（41–47 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓推到近景后定格成关键帧静帧，冲击靠剪辑｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：汤；题字「祷」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势｜动作：桑林之中，他剪下自己的头发｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨缓缓铺开后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：雷声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汤走进了桑林——」
镜头 6（47–55 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：汤｜动作：正史结局：汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。」
镜头 7（55–61 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸，左侧留出竖排引文的位置，右下角留出朱印的位置（文字与印章后期叠加）｜动作：纸面静止，只有淡墨水痕缓缓洇开；后期叠加引文逐字显现、朱印落下｜水墨效果：淡墨水痕洇开，纸纹若隐若现｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜后期叠加文字：引文「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」——《史记·殷本纪》，竖排楷书；朱印「汤诰」｜旁白：「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：鸟鸣、宫殿回响、战后余风、寂静室内；音效：绳索、青铜钟声、干风、雷声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「网开三面」、副题「汤祷桑林」、朱印「汤诰」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」——《史记·殷本纪》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫；不出现任何现代元素：现代建筑、电线、电线杆、公路、车辆、玻璃、塑料、现代服饰、眼镜、手表、枪械、电灯、招牌或文字标识
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE) · Open the Net on Three Sides: Tang Prays at the Mulberry Grove (「网开三面」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 61 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE), c. 1599 BCE — rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots.

Characters:
- Tang (汤) — ruler, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhang Wangzhe (张网者) — commoner, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yi Yin (伊尹) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhong Hui (仲虺) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, trees, tree canopy | Action: In the wild a net is spread on all four sides | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: birdsong | Text added in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「网开三面」 with vermilion seal 「汤诰」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汤还没有伐夏的时候，有一次出行，看见野外的人张网四面，祝祷说：天下四方的鸟都进我的网。」
Shot 2 (11–23 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Tang, Zhang Wangzhe | Action: Tang orders three sides removed, leaving only one | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: birdsong; SFX: rope | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汤说：这样就把它们捉尽了。他让人去掉三面，只留一面，祝道：想往左的往左，想往右的往右，不听命的，再进我的网。」
Shot 3 (23–33 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: crowd, banners | Action: At Bo the lords stand below the steps to hear his decree | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: vertical kaishu quotation 「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「诸侯听说了，说汤的德行连禽兽都顾到了。后来汤灭了夏，回到亳都，作《汤诰》告诫诸侯。」
Shot 4 (33–41 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sand; subject: Tang | Action: Great drought; the fields crack and nothing grows for five years | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: dry wind | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《吕氏春秋》又说，汤得天下之后，天大旱，五年没有收成。」
Shot 5 (41–47 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push to a close shot that holds as a keyframe still; impact comes from the edit | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Tang; calligraphy 「祷」 added in post; the frame keeps only the dry-brush gesture | Action: In the mulberry grove he cuts off his own hair | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big ink wash spreads slowly, then holds as a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: thunder | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汤走进了桑林——」
Shot 6 (47–55 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Tang | Action: Canonical outcome: Tang reforms the calendar and colours of state; the institutions of Shang are founded. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汤改正朔，易服色，上白，朝会以昼。殷商的制度从此立了下来。」
Shot 7 (55–61 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper with space on the left for a vertical quotation and at lower right for the seal (both added in post) | Action: the paper stays still with only a pale ink bleed spreading; in post the quotation appears character by character and the seal stamps last | Ink FX: pale ink bleed spreading, faint paper grain | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | Text added in post: quotation 「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」 — 《史记·殷本纪》, vertical kaishu; vermilion seal 「汤诰」 | VO (Mandarin): 「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: birdsong, palace hall reverb, lingering wind after battle, quiet room tone; SFX: rope, bronze bell, dry wind, thunder; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「网开三面」, subtitle 「汤祷桑林」 and vermilion seal 「汤诰」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「欲左，左。欲右，右。不用命，乃入吾网。」 — 《史记·殷本纪》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups; no modern elements: no modern buildings, power lines, poles, roads, vehicles, glass, plastic, modern clothing, eyeglasses, watches, guns, electric lights, signs or lettering

strings.scene.shang.tonggong.title: 桐宫
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.subtitle: 伊尹放太甲
strings.vo.01: 成汤崩，太子太丁未立而卒。外丙、中壬先后即位，都不长久。
strings.vo.02: 伊尹立太丁之子太甲。太甲即位三年，不明，暴虐，不遵汤法。
strings.vo.03: 伊尹把他放到桐宫，自己摄行政事，当国以朝诸侯。
strings.vo.04: 桐宫在汤的墓旁。太甲在那里住了三年。
strings.vo.05: 三年之后，伊尹要去看他是否真的悔过——
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.quote: 帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.fork.prompt: 桐宫——依《史记》直书，还是听异说「伊尹自立」？
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.pick.canon: 正史 · 《史记·殷本纪》《孟子》所载
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.canon.intro: 伊尹手里握着国政，又握着一个被放逐的王。摄政三年，他不能让诸侯以为商已换了主人。
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.end.canon: 伊尹迎太甲而授之政。太甲修德，诸侯咸归，号为太宗。伊尹作《太甲训》三篇褒之。
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自古本《竹书纪年》佚文，与《史记》《孟子》所记相反，是汲冢书引起的著名异说。
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.legend.intro: 竹书说：伊尹放太甲于桐，乃自立。七年之后，太甲潜出桐宫，杀了伊尹。
strings.scene.shang.tonggong.end.legend: 太甲复位，伊尹之子仍得田宅。竹书与《史记》经过相反，结果同为太甲复位。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

characters.en: Yi Zhi (伊陟) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 成汤崩，太子太丁未立而卒。外丙、中壬先后即位，都不长久。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、殿柱、屋檐｜动作：亳都宫室，远山一抹｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响｜后期叠加文字：片名「桐宫」竖排书法与朱印「桐宫三年」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「成汤崩，太子太丁未立而卒。外丙、中壬先后即位，都不长久。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: Palaces of Bo with a smear of distant hills | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb | Text added in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「桐宫」 with vermilion seal 「桐宫三年」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「成汤崩，太子太丁未立而卒。外丙、中壬先后即位，都不长久。」

shots.vo: 伊尹立太丁之子太甲。太甲即位三年，不明，暴虐，不遵汤法。

shots.en: Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Yi Yin, crowd, banners | Action: Tang dies; Wai Bing and Zhong Ren reign briefly in turn | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「伊尹立太丁之子太甲。太甲即位三年，不明，暴虐，不遵汤法。」

shots.vo: 伊尹把他放到桐宫，自己摄行政事，当国以朝诸侯。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（16–23 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：太甲｜动作：太甲即位，不遵汤法｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：低语｜后期叠加文字：引文「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「伊尹把他放到桐宫，自己摄行政事，当国以朝诸侯。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (16–23 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Tai Jia | Action: Taijia takes the throne and ignores Tang's laws | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: murmuring | Text added in post: vertical kaishu quotation 「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「伊尹把他放到桐宫，自己摄行政事，当国以朝诸侯。」

shots.vo: 桐宫在汤的墓旁。太甲在那里住了三年。

shots.en: Shot 4 (23–29 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Yi Yin, Tai Jia | Action: Yi Yin sends Taijia to Tong Palace beside Tang's tomb | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: forest birds; SFX: footsteps | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「桐宫在汤的墓旁。太甲在那里住了三年。」

shots.vo: 三年之后，伊尹要去看他是否真的悔过——

shots.en: Shot 5 (29–35 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push to a close shot that holds as a keyframe still; impact comes from the edit | Composition: subject: crowd; calligraphy 「迎王一笔」 added in post; the frame keeps only the dry-brush gesture | Action: Three years later Yi Yin leads the officials to bring him back | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big ink wash spreads slowly, then holds as a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「三年之后，伊尹要去看他是否真的悔过——」

shots.vo: 伊尹迎太甲而授之政。太甲修德，诸侯咸归，号为太宗。伊尹作《太甲训》三篇褒之。

shots.en: Shot 6 (35–45 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Yi Yin returns the government; Taijia reforms, the lords return, and he is honoured as Taizong. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「伊尹迎太甲而授之政。太甲修德，诸侯咸归，号为太宗。伊尹作《太甲训》三篇褒之。」

shots.vo: 帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。

shots.en: Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper with space on the left for a vertical quotation and at lower right for the seal (both added in post) | Action: the paper stays still with only a pale ink bleed spreading; in post the quotation appears character by character and the seal stamps last | Ink FX: pale ink bleed spreading, faint paper grain | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | Text added in post: quotation 「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」 — 《史记·殷本纪》, vertical kaishu; vermilion seal 「桐宫三年」 | VO (Mandarin): 「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：宫殿回响、林中鸟鸣、战后余风；音效：青铜钟声、低语、脚步声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, forest birds, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell, murmuring, footsteps; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「桐宫」、副题「伊尹放太甲」、朱印「桐宫三年」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」——《史记·殷本纪》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「桐宫」, subtitle 「伊尹放太甲」 and vermilion seal 「桐宫三年」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」 — 《史记·殷本纪》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 成汤崩，太子太丁未立而卒。外丙、中壬先后即位，都不长久。
伊尹立太丁之子太甲。太甲即位三年，不明，暴虐，不遵汤法。
伊尹把他放到桐宫，自己摄行政事，当国以朝诸侯。
桐宫在汤的墓旁。太甲在那里住了三年。
三年之后，伊尹要去看他是否真的悔过——
伊尹迎太甲而授之政。太甲修德，诸侯咸归，号为太宗。伊尹作《太甲训》三篇褒之。
帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】商 · 桐宫（伊尹放太甲）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 51 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：商 · （约前 16 世纪）。夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。

镜头 5（29–35 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓推到近景后定格成关键帧静帧，冲击靠剪辑｜构图：主体：众人；题字「迎王一笔」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势｜动作：三年后，伊尹率百官往迎｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨缓缓铺开后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：青铜钟声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「三年之后，伊尹要去看他是否真的悔过——」
镜头 6（35–45 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：伊尹迎太甲而授之政。太甲修德，诸侯咸归，号为太宗。伊尹作《太甲训》三篇褒之。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「伊尹迎太甲而授之政。太甲修德，诸侯咸归，号为太宗。伊尹作《太甲训》三篇褒之。」
镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸，左侧留出竖排引文的位置，右下角留出朱印的位置（文字与印章后期叠加）｜动作：纸面静止，只有淡墨水痕缓缓洇开；后期叠加引文逐字显现、朱印落下｜水墨效果：淡墨水痕洇开，纸纹若隐若现｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜后期叠加文字：引文「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」——《史记·殷本纪》，竖排楷书；朱印「桐宫三年」｜旁白：「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」

声音：背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：宫殿回响、林中鸟鸣、战后余风；音效：青铜钟声、低语、脚步声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「桐宫」、副题「伊尹放太甲」、朱印「桐宫三年」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」——《史记·殷本纪》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫；不出现任何现代元素：现代建筑、电线、电线杆、公路、车辆、玻璃、塑料、现代服饰、眼镜、手表、枪械、电灯、招牌或文字标识
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE) · Tong Palace: Yi Yin Exiles Taijia (「桐宫」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 51 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE), c. 1580 BCE — rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots.

Characters:
- Yi Yin (伊尹) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Tai Jia (太甲) — ruler, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wai Bing (外丙) — royal / consort, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhong Ren (中壬) — royal / consort, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yi Zhi (伊陟) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: Palaces of Bo with a smear of distant hills | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb | Text added in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「桐宫」 with vermilion seal 「桐宫三年」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「成汤崩，太子太丁未立而卒。外丙、中壬先后即位，都不长久。」
Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Yi Yin, crowd, banners | Action: Tang dies; Wai Bing and Zhong Ren reign briefly in turn | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「伊尹立太丁之子太甲。太甲即位三年，不明，暴虐，不遵汤法。」
Shot 3 (16–23 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Tai Jia | Action: Taijia takes the throne and ignores Tang's laws | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: murmuring | Text added in post: vertical kaishu quotation 「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「伊尹把他放到桐宫，自己摄行政事，当国以朝诸侯。」
Shot 4 (23–29 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Yi Yin, Tai Jia | Action: Yi Yin sends Taijia to Tong Palace beside Tang's tomb | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: forest birds; SFX: footsteps | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「桐宫在汤的墓旁。太甲在那里住了三年。」
Shot 5 (29–35 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push to a close shot that holds as a keyframe still; impact comes from the edit | Composition: subject: crowd; calligraphy 「迎王一笔」 added in post; the frame keeps only the dry-brush gesture | Action: Three years later Yi Yin leads the officials to bring him back | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big ink wash spreads slowly, then holds as a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「三年之后，伊尹要去看他是否真的悔过——」
Shot 6 (35–45 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Yi Yin returns the government; Taijia reforms, the lords return, and he is honoured as Taizong. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「伊尹迎太甲而授之政。太甲修德，诸侯咸归，号为太宗。伊尹作《太甲训》三篇褒之。」
Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper with space on the left for a vertical quotation and at lower right for the seal (both added in post) | Action: the paper stays still with only a pale ink bleed spreading; in post the quotation appears character by character and the seal stamps last | Ink FX: pale ink bleed spreading, faint paper grain | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | Text added in post: quotation 「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」 — 《史记·殷本纪》, vertical kaishu; vermilion seal 「桐宫三年」 | VO (Mandarin): 「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」

Sound: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, forest birds, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell, murmuring, footsteps; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「桐宫」, subtitle 「伊尹放太甲」 and vermilion seal 「桐宫三年」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「帝太甲居桐宫三年，悔过自责，反善。」 — 《史记·殷本纪》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups; no modern elements: no modern buildings, power lines, poles, roads, vehicles, glass, plastic, modern clothing, eyeglasses, watches, guns, electric lights, signs or lettering

strings.scene.shang.pangeng.title: 盘庚迁殷
strings.scene.shang.pangeng.subtitle: 殷人渡河
strings.vo.01: 自中丁以来，商人屡迁其都，王室争立，诸侯不朝。
strings.vo.02: 盘庚欲迁于殷。众臣多不欲徙，民亦怨之。
strings.vo.03: 盘庚三次告谕，以先王之事说之：迁，是为了安民。
strings.vo.05: 自此至纣之亡，商人不再迁都——
strings.scene.shang.pangeng.fork.prompt: 盘庚迁殷——依《尚书》直书，还是听异说「迁往何处」？
strings.scene.shang.pangeng.canon.intro: 河北的旧都一迁再迁，王室争立，诸侯不朝。盘庚要说服的，是一族不愿离开故土的人。
strings.scene.shang.pangeng.end.canon: 殷人定居新邑，商道复兴。
strings.scene.shang.pangeng.legend.disclaimer: 以下是史料之间的分歧，不是传说：《史记》与古本《竹书纪年》对盘庚迁往何处说法不同。
strings.scene.shang.pangeng.legend.intro: 《史记》说盘庚渡河南，复居成汤故居；古本《竹书纪年》佚文说盘庚自奄迁于北蒙，曰殷。殷墟考古发现也加入了讨论。
strings.scene.shang.pangeng.end.legend: 史料各执一说，考古给出线索。无论哪种说法，盘庚迁殷都成了商代后期的开端。

画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：2×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 盘庚（商王）（商·君主）；2. 众臣（在位者）（商·文臣）。
第 2 行：3. 殷民（众庶）（商·其他）；4. 小辛（盘庚之弟）（商·宗室后妃）。
排版参考尺寸：1024×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 商 · （约前 1300 年）。夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。
setting.en: Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE), c. 1300 BCE — rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots.

characters.name: 盘庚
characters.zh: 盘庚（商·商王）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；排众议迁都于殷，作《盘庚》三篇以告民
characters.en: Pan Geng (盘庚) — ruler, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 众臣
characters.zh: 众臣（商·在位者）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；多不欲徙，盘庚以先王之事告之
characters.en: Zhong Chen (众臣) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 殷民
characters.zh: 殷民（商·众庶）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；“咨胥皆怨，不欲徙”
characters.en: Yin Min (殷民) — commoner, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 小辛
characters.zh: 小辛（商·盘庚之弟）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；宗室贵胄华服，玉佩冠带；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；盘庚崩后继位
characters.en: Xiao Xin (小辛) — royal / consort, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 自中丁以来，商人屡迁其都，王室争立，诸侯不朝。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–7 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、城墙雉堞｜动作：河北旧都，城郭衰败｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜后期叠加文字：片名「盘庚迁殷」竖排书法与朱印「盘庚迁殷」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「自中丁以来，商人屡迁其都，王室争立，诸侯不朝。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, crenellated city wall | Action: The old capital north of the river, its walls decaying | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | Text added in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「盘庚迁殷」 with vermilion seal 「盘庚迁殷」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「自中丁以来，商人屡迁其都，王室争立，诸侯不朝。」

shots.vo: 盘庚欲迁于殷。众臣多不欲徙，民亦怨之。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（7–13 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：盘庚、众人｜动作：盘庚登堂，告众臣以先王之事｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「盘庚欲迁于殷。众臣多不欲徙，民亦怨之。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (7–13 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Pan Geng, crowd | Action: Pangeng addresses the court, citing the former kings | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「盘庚欲迁于殷。众臣多不欲徙，民亦怨之。」

shots.vo: 盘庚三次告谕，以先王之事说之：迁，是为了安民。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（13–20 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，紧张感靠剪辑节奏，不做生成的手持震动｜构图：主体：众人；题字「雨」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势｜动作：殷民聚众，“咨胥皆怨”｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；细密斜线笔触成雨｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：低语｜后期叠加文字：引文「若颠木之有由蘖。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「盘庚三次告谕，以先王之事说之：迁，是为了安民。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (13–20 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off; tension comes from editing rhythm, not generated handheld shake | Composition: subject: crowd; calligraphy 「雨」 added in post; the frame keeps only the dry-brush gesture | Action: The people gather, sighing and complaining | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; fine slanted strokes for rain | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: murmuring | Text added in post: vertical kaishu quotation 「若颠木之有由蘖。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「盘庚三次告谕，以先王之事说之：迁，是为了安民。」

shots.vo: 于是渡河，举族而迁。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（20–26 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：河水、舟；主体：盘庚｜动作：渡河：舟楫相接｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：摇橹｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「于是渡河，举族而迁。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (20–26 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: Pan Geng | Action: Crossing the river: boats linked end to end | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「于是渡河，举族而迁。」

shots.vo: 自此至纣之亡，商人不再迁都——

narration: 自中丁以来，商人屡迁其都，王室争立，诸侯不朝。
盘庚欲迁于殷。众臣多不欲徙，民亦怨之。
盘庚三次告谕，以先王之事说之：迁，是为了安民。
于是渡河，举族而迁。
自此至纣之亡，商人不再迁都——
殷人定居新邑，商道复兴。
若颠木之有由蘖。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE) · Pangeng Moves to Yin (「盘庚迁殷」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 44 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE), c. 1300 BCE — rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots.

Characters:
- Pan Geng (盘庚) — ruler, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhong Chen (众臣) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yin Min (殷民) — commoner, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.shang.fuhao.title: 妇好
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.subtitle: 女将出征
strings.vo.01: 武丁即位，三年不言，政事决于冢宰，以观国风。
strings.vo.02: 他得傅说为相，殷国大治。卜辞里，还有一个常被提起的名字。
strings.vo.03: 妇好。王为她卜问出征吉凶，卜问她的病，卜问她的生育。
strings.vo.04: 卜辞记她领兵伐土方、羌方、巴方，一次征集之众多达上万。
strings.vo.05: 甲骨上的裂纹，指向西方——
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.fork.prompt: 妇好——依《史记》直书，还是听后世「三千年后的探方」？
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.pick.canon: 正史 · 《殷本纪》与甲骨卜辞所载
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.canon.intro: 《史记》里没有妇好。她的事迹刻在甲骨上，三千年后才被读出来。这一卷，按卜辞出征。
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.end.canon: 妇好凯旋，又主持祭祀。她先武丁而卒，葬于殷都宫殿区附近，王还为她卜问冥福。
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.pick.legend: 后世 · 三千年后的探方
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.legend.disclaimer: 以下是 1976 年殷墟妇好墓发掘的经过，属“后世”之事：不是古代传说，而是今人重新找到她的过程。
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.legend.intro: 1976 年，考古队在安阳小屯发掘一座未被盗掘的商墓，出土铜器上铸着两个字：妇好。
strings.scene.shang.fuhao.end.legend: 铭文与卜辞对上了。三千年后，史书漏掉的女将重新有了名字，与卜辞所记。

artPrompts.prompt:
黑白红武侠水墨剪影素材图（水墨特效），题材：妇好·女将出征（约前 1250—前 1192 年）。
画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：4×3 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 刀光斩击；4. 血点（朱红，克制）。
第 2 行：5. 箭矢破空；6. 命中靶心墨点；7. 水流笔迹；8. 墨滴下坠。
第 3 行：9. 风卷旗影；10. 冲阵烟尘；11. 火（过场笔画所绘）；12. 留空。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 商 · （约前 1250—前 1192 年）。夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。
setting.en: Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE), 1250 BCE–1192 BCE — rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots.

characters.name: 妇好
characters.zh: 妇好（商·武丁之妇）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，青铜钺与戈，贵族高冠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；卜辞所见率兵征伐土方、羌方、巴方、夷方，主持祭祀
characters.en: Fu Hao (妇好) — general, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, bronze axes and dagger-axes, tall noble caps; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 贞人
characters.zh: 贞人（商·占卜之官）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；在甲骨上刻下卜问与验辞
characters.en: Zhen Ren (贞人) — commoner, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 羌方
characters.zh: 羌方（羌·商的西方方国）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；卜辞所见武丁时期的主要征伐对象之一
characters.en: Qiang Fang (羌方) — commoner, Qiang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 武丁
characters.zh: 武丁（商·商王）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；《殷本纪》：得傅说为相，殷国大治；卜辞中屡为妇好占卜
characters.en: Wu Ding (武丁) — ruler, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 傅说
characters.zh: 傅说（商·武丁之相）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；《殷本纪》：武丁梦得圣人，求于傅险
characters.en: Fu Shuo (傅说) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 祖己
characters.zh: 祖己（商·贤臣）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；《殷本纪》：武丁祭成汤，有飞雉登鼎耳而呴，祖己训王修政行德
characters.en: Zu Ji (祖己) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 武丁即位，三年不言，政事决于冢宰，以观国风。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、近山与地面｜动作：殷都之外，洹水与远山｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜后期叠加文字：片名「妇好」竖排书法与朱印「妇好」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「武丁即位，三年不言，政事决于冢宰，以观国风。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, near hills and ground | Action: Outside the Yin capital, the Huan River and distant hills | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | Text added in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「妇好」 with vermilion seal 「妇好」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「武丁即位，三年不言，政事决于冢宰，以观国风。」

shots.vo: 他得傅说为相，殷国大治。卜辞里，还有一个常被提起的名字。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（6–14 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：卜；主体：贞人、火｜动作：贞人灼龟，裂纹爬满甲骨｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；淡墨烟气缓缓横移（不扭曲画面）｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：骨裂（甲骨灼裂）｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他得傅说为相，殷国大治。卜辞里，还有一个常被提起的名字。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (6–14 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: 卜; subject: Zhen Ren, fire (splashed ink) | Action: A diviner scorches a turtle shell; cracks spread across the bone | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; pale ink smoke drifting slowly sideways (no warping of the frame) | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: cracking oracle bone | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他得傅说为相，殷国大治。卜辞里，还有一个常被提起的名字。」

shots.vo: 妇好。王为她卜问出征吉凶，卜问她的病，卜问她的生育。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（14–21 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：妇好、军阵、长兵如林、旌旗｜动作：妇好受命，三千之众与万旅集结｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：远处鼓声、号角｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「妇好。王为她卜问出征吉凶，卜问她的病，卜问她的生育。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (14–21 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Fu Hao, army ranks, forest of spears, banners | Action: Fu Hao takes command; three thousand troops and ten thousand more assemble | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: distant drums, horn | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「妇好。王为她卜问出征吉凶，卜问她的病，卜问她的生育。」

shots.vo: 卜辞记她领兵伐土方、羌方、巴方，一次征集之众多达上万。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（21–29 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，紧张感靠剪辑节奏，不做生成的手持震动｜构图：主体：羌方、骑兵、弓箭｜动作：西出伐羌，战车卷起尘土｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：兵刃相击、箭雨｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卜辞记她领兵伐土方、羌方、巴方，一次征集之众多达上万。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (21–29 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off; tension comes from editing rhythm, not generated handheld shake | Composition: subject: Qiang Fang, cavalry, bow | Action: Marching west against the Qiang, chariots raise dust | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons, rain of arrows | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卜辞记她领兵伐土方、羌方、巴方，一次征集之众多达上万。」

shots.vo: 甲骨上的裂纹，指向西方——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（29–35 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓推到近景后定格成关键帧静帧，冲击靠剪辑｜构图：主体：大刀；题字「妇好之钺」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势｜动作：大钺一挥｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；刃口一笔留白如寒光；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨缓缓铺开后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：青铜钟声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「甲骨上的裂纹，指向西方——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (29–35 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push to a close shot that holds as a keyframe still; impact comes from the edit | Composition: subject: broadsword; calligraphy 「妇好之钺」 added in post; the frame keeps only the dry-brush gesture | Action: A great bronze axe swings | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; a single paper-white stroke along the blade edge; freeze into a still ink painting; a big ink wash spreads slowly, then holds as a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「甲骨上的裂纹，指向西方——」

shots.vo: 妇好凯旋，又主持祭祀。她先武丁而卒，葬于殷都宫殿区附近，王还为她卜问冥福。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（35–45 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：妇好凯旋，又主持祭祀。她先武丁而卒，葬于殷都宫殿区附近，王还为她卜问冥福。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「妇好凯旋，又主持祭祀。她先武丁而卒，葬于殷都宫殿区附近，王还为她卜问冥福。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (35–45 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Fu Hao returns victorious and leads sacrifices; she dies before King Wu Ding, who divines for her in the afterlife. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「妇好凯旋，又主持祭祀。她先武丁而卒，葬于殷都宫殿区附近，王还为她卜问冥福。」

shots.zh: 镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸，左侧留出竖排引文的位置，右下角留出朱印的位置（文字与印章后期叠加）｜动作：纸面静止，只有淡墨水痕缓缓洇开；后期叠加引文逐字显现、朱印落下｜水墨效果：淡墨水痕洇开，纸纹若隐若现｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜后期叠加文字：引文，竖排楷书；朱印「妇好」
shots.en: Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper with space on the left for a vertical quotation and at lower right for the seal (both added in post) | Action: the paper stays still with only a pale ink bleed spreading; in post the quotation appears character by character and the seal stamps last | Ink FX: pale ink bleed spreading, faint paper grain | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | Text added in post: quotation, vertical kaishu; vermilion seal 「妇好」

sound.zh: 背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、宫殿回响、军营鼓声、远处厮杀声、战后余风；音效：骨裂（甲骨灼裂）、远处鼓声、号角、兵刃相击、箭雨、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, palace hall reverb, camp drums, distant battle, lingering wind after battle; SFX: cracking oracle bone, distant drums, horn, clashing weapons, rain of arrows, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「妇好」、副题「女将出征」、朱印「妇好」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「妇好」, subtitle 「女将出征」 and vermilion seal 「妇好」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 武丁即位，三年不言，政事决于冢宰，以观国风。
他得傅说为相，殷国大治。卜辞里，还有一个常被提起的名字。
妇好。王为她卜问出征吉凶，卜问她的病，卜问她的生育。
卜辞记她领兵伐土方、羌方、巴方，一次征集之众多达上万。
甲骨上的裂纹，指向西方——
妇好凯旋，又主持祭祀。她先武丁而卒，葬于殷都宫殿区附近，王还为她卜问冥福。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】商 · 妇好（女将出征）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 51 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：商 · （约前 1250—前 1192 年）。夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。

人物：
- 妇好（商·武丁之妇）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，青铜钺与戈，贵族高冠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；卜辞所见率兵征伐土方、羌方、巴方、夷方，主持祭祀
- 贞人（商·占卜之官）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；在甲骨上刻下卜问与验辞
- 羌方（羌·商的西方方国）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；卜辞所见武丁时期的主要征伐对象之一
- 武丁（商·商王）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；《殷本纪》：得傅说为相，殷国大治；卜辞中屡为妇好占卜
- 傅说（商·武丁之相）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；《殷本纪》：武丁梦得圣人，求于傅险
- 祖己（商·贤臣）：交领右衽窄袖衣，玄赭二色，贵族高冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；《殷本纪》：武丁祭成汤，有飞雉登鼎耳而呴，祖己训王修政行德

分镜：
镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、近山与地面｜动作：殷都之外，洹水与远山｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜后期叠加文字：片名「妇好」竖排书法与朱印「妇好」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「武丁即位，三年不言，政事决于冢宰，以观国风。」
镜头 2（6–14 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：卜；主体：贞人、火｜动作：贞人灼龟，裂纹爬满甲骨｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；淡墨烟气缓缓横移（不扭曲画面）｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：骨裂（甲骨灼裂）｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他得傅说为相，殷国大治。卜辞里，还有一个常被提起的名字。」
镜头 3（14–21 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：妇好、军阵、长兵如林、旌旗｜动作：妇好受命，三千之众与万旅集结｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：远处鼓声、号角｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「妇好。王为她卜问出征吉凶，卜问她的病，卜问她的生育。」
镜头 4（21–29 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，紧张感靠剪辑节奏，不做生成的手持震动｜构图：主体：羌方、骑兵、弓箭｜动作：西出伐羌，战车卷起尘土｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：兵刃相击、箭雨｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卜辞记她领兵伐土方、羌方、巴方，一次征集之众多达上万。」
镜头 5（29–35 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓推到近景后定格成关键帧静帧，冲击靠剪辑｜构图：主体：大刀；题字「妇好之钺」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势｜动作：大钺一挥｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；刃口一笔留白如寒光；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨缓缓铺开后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：青铜钟声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「甲骨上的裂纹，指向西方——」
镜头 6（35–45 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：妇好凯旋，又主持祭祀。她先武丁而卒，葬于殷都宫殿区附近，王还为她卜问冥福。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜后期叠加文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「妇好凯旋，又主持祭祀。她先武丁而卒，葬于殷都宫殿区附近，王还为她卜问冥福。」
镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸，左侧留出竖排引文的位置，右下角留出朱印的位置（文字与印章后期叠加）｜动作：纸面静止，只有淡墨水痕缓缓洇开；后期叠加引文逐字显现、朱印落下｜水墨效果：淡墨水痕洇开，纸纹若隐若现｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜后期叠加文字：引文，竖排楷书；朱印「妇好」

声音：背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、宫殿回响、军营鼓声、远处厮杀声、战后余风；音效：骨裂（甲骨灼裂）、远处鼓声、号角、兵刃相击、箭雨、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「妇好」、副题「女将出征」、朱印「妇好」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫；不出现任何现代元素：现代建筑、电线、电线杆、公路、车辆、玻璃、塑料、现代服饰、眼镜、手表、枪械、电灯、招牌或文字标识
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE) · Fu Hao, Woman General (「妇好」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 51 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BCE), 1250 BCE–1192 BCE — rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots.

Characters:
- Fu Hao (妇好) — general, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, bronze axes and dagger-axes, tall noble caps; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhen Ren (贞人) — commoner, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Qiang Fang (羌方) — commoner, Qiang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wu Ding (武丁) — ruler, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Fu Shuo (傅说) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zu Ji (祖己) — minister, Shang; narrow-sleeved cross-collar robes in black and ochre, tall noble caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, near hills and ground | Action: Outside the Yin capital, the Huan River and distant hills | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | Text added in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「妇好」 with vermilion seal 「妇好」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「武丁即位，三年不言，政事决于冢宰，以观国风。」
Shot 2 (6–14 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: 卜; subject: Zhen Ren, fire (splashed ink) | Action: A diviner scorches a turtle shell; cracks spread across the bone | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; pale ink smoke drifting slowly sideways (no warping of the frame) | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: cracking oracle bone | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他得傅说为相，殷国大治。卜辞里，还有一个常被提起的名字。」
Shot 3 (14–21 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Fu Hao, army ranks, forest of spears, banners | Action: Fu Hao takes command; three thousand troops and ten thousand more assemble | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: distant drums, horn | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「妇好。王为她卜问出征吉凶，卜问她的病，卜问她的生育。」
Shot 4 (21–29 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off; tension comes from editing rhythm, not generated handheld shake | Composition: subject: Qiang Fang, cavalry, bow | Action: Marching west against the Qiang, chariots raise dust | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons, rain of arrows | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卜辞记她领兵伐土方、羌方、巴方，一次征集之众多达上万。」
Shot 5 (29–35 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push to a close shot that holds as a keyframe still; impact comes from the edit | Composition: subject: broadsword; calligraphy 「妇好之钺」 added in post; the frame keeps only the dry-brush gesture | Action: A great bronze axe swings | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; a single paper-white stroke along the blade edge; freeze into a still ink painting; a big ink wash spreads slowly, then holds as a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | Text added in post: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「甲骨上的裂纹，指向西方——」

strings.scene.shang.youli.title: 羑里
strings.scene.shang.youli.subtitle: 西伯拘而演易
strings.vo.01: 西伯姬昌积善累德，诸侯都向着他。崇侯虎对纣说：西伯这样下去，对帝不利。
strings.vo.02: 纣就把西伯囚禁在羑里。
strings.vo.03: 司马迁后来写道：西伯被拘的时候，推演了《周易》。
strings.vo.04: 周人闳夭等人忧心忡忡，找来有莘氏的美女、骊戎的文马、有熊氏的九驷，通过纣的宠臣费仲献了上去。
strings.scene.shang.youli.quote: 此一物足以释西伯，况其多乎！
strings.scene.shang.youli.fork.prompt: 羑里——依《史记》直书，还是听演义「伯邑考进贡」？
strings.scene.shang.youli.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·周本纪》所载
strings.scene.shang.youli.canon.intro: 羑里的囚室里没有别的事可做。西伯把蓍草排开，一遍一遍地推演。门外，周人在为他的自由四处奔走。
strings.scene.shang.youli.end.canon: 纣赦西伯，赐之弓矢斧钺，使得专征伐。西伯归周，献洛西之地，请纣除炮格之刑，纣许之。
strings.scene.shang.youli.legend.disclaimer: 以下取明代神魔小说《封神演义》第十一回“羑里城囚西伯侯”、第十九回“伯邑考进贡赎罪”、第二十二回“西伯侯文王吐子”：伯邑考入朝赎父被害，纣以其肉作羹赐西伯。这是小说情节，《史记》无伯邑考被烹之事。
strings.scene.shang.youli.legend.intro: 西伯的长子伯邑考，带着七香车、醒酒毡、白面猿猴，来到朝歌，要替父亲赎罪。
strings.scene.shang.youli.end.legend: 小说里，西伯忍痛吞羹，回到岐山才吐出。正史里，西伯同样被放了回去。
